Players Committee card image of [[Clone Squad Leader]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Your other clones present are each forfeit +1. Once during battle with your clone, may cancel and redraw your just drawn battle destiny. When moving with a 'squad' of up to three other clones, they all move simultaneously for 1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/clonesquadleader.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/clonesquadleader.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
